staticPages.title: Contact us
staticPages.seoDescription: Get in touch with the Kashmiri Jewels team.

children.text: Reach out to us at kashmirijewels@gmail.com for any questions, concerns, or feedback. We would love to hear from you.

Your privacy matters to us. We collect only the information necessary to process your orders and improve your shopping experience. We do not share your personal data with third parties except as required for payment processing and shipping.

children.text: Each Kashmiri Jewels order is packed carefully for safe delivery. Shipping timelines, return eligibility, and refund details are confirmed with your order so every purchase is handled clearly and securely.

By using Kashmiri Jewels, you agree to these terms. All products are subject to availability. We reserve the right to cancel orders in case of stock unavailability or pricing errors. Prices are in Indian Rupees and include applicable taxes.
